metas.name: The Bodyguard
metas.description: A skilled bodyguard is assigned to protect a reclusive movie star from a stalker and must pose as his girlfriend to keep the threat hidden. On his family ranch, the assignment blurs lines as proximity complicates the job.

metas.name: Steps
metas.description: Blamed for magical mischief at the Royal Ball, stepsister Lilith turns her sister into a frog. She must work with Cinderella and a troll to save the kingdom and prove villains deserve happy endings too.

metas.name: Tony
metas.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Home Alone
metas.description: An eight-year-old troublemaker, mistakenly left home alone, must defend his home against a pair of burglars on Christmas Eve.

metas.name: Ali G: Who Iz I?
metas.description: Hip-hop journalist Ali G returns after 20 years to make a documentary with real people. Cameras follow him for over a year as he takes classes, walks the streets, and appears on shows, often with his pregnant girlfriend.

metas.name: The Invite
metas.description: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places.

metas.name: The Muppet Show
metas.description: Kermit and friends return in a modern take on their classic variety show format, mixing nostalgic charm with new comedy bits while staying true to the Muppets' timeless spirit.

metas.name: The Drama
metas.description: A happily-engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

metas.name: Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood
metas.description: As Hollywood's Golden Age is winding down, a television actor and his stunt double endeavor to achieve lasting success.

metas.name: Red One
metas.description: After Santa Claus is kidnapped, the North Pole's Head of Security must team up with a notorious hacker in a globe-trotting, action-packed mission to save Christmas.

metas.name: Runner
metas.description: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

metas.name: Mayday
metas.description: Lieutenant Troy Brennan's reconnaissance mission over Soviet territory goes awry, forcing him to crash-land and survive in Russian wilderness while evading capture or rescue.

metas.name: Elf
metas.description: A man raised by Santa's elves travels from the North Pole to New York City to meet his biological father, who doesn't know he exists and is in desperate need of some Christmas spirit.

metas.name: The Sheep Detectives
metas.description: Every night a shepherd reads aloud a murder mystery, pretending his sheep can understand. When he is found dead, the sheep realize at once that it was a murder and think they know everything about how to go about solving it.

metas.name: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
metas.description: A "Man From the Future" arrives at a diner in Los Angeles where he must recruit the precise combination of disgruntled patrons to join him on a one-night quest to save the world from the terminal threat of a rogue artificial intel...

metas.name: How to Make a Killing
metas.description: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, blue-collar Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

metas.name: Wake Up Dead Man
metas.description: Detective Benoit Blanc teams up with an earnest young priest to investigate a perfectly impossible crime at a small-town church with a dark history.

metas.name: Bugonia
metas.description: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap the high-powered CEO of a major company, convinced that she is an alien intent on destroying planet Earth.

metas.name: The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare
metas.description: The British military recruits a small group of highly skilled soldiers to strike against German forces behind enemy lines during World War II.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenaged daughter.

metas.name: Marty Supreme
metas.description: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: The Gentlemen
metas.description: An American expat tries to sell off his highly profitable marijuana empire in London, triggering plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.

metas.name: Practical Magic 2
metas.description: A multi generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

metas.name: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
metas.description: A mother personally challenges the local authorities to solve her daughter's murder when they fail to catch the culprit.

metas.name: Coyote vs. Acme
metas.description: After enduring years of malfunctioning products, Wile E. Coyote teams up with a local personal injury attorney to take on ACME, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

metas.name: Nativity!
metas.description: An uptight but secretly heartbroken primary school teacher's little white lie about Hollywood coming to see his class' nativity play grows like wildfire in his rag-tag school low on self-esteem.

metas.name: Love Actually
metas.description: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

metas.name: Violent Night
metas.description: When an elite team of mercenaries breaks into a family compound on Christmas Eve, a disgruntled Santa Claus must take them out to save both the hostages and his Holiday.

metas.name: Meet the Parents
metas.description: A chronic underachiever meets his girlfriend's parents before proposing, but unfortunately for him her father is an overprotective former CIA agent.

metas.name: The Love Hypothesis
metas.description: After an impulsive kiss, two scientists end up in a fake relationship, testing their theories about love and each other.

metas.name: Minions & Monsters
metas.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.

metas.name: Bad Apples
metas.description: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

metas.name: The Nice Guys
metas.description: In 1970s Los Angeles, a mismatched pair of private eyes investigate a missing girl and the mysterious death of a porn star.

metas.name: One Night Only
metas.description: Two New Yorkers search for love on the one night of the year when pre-marital sex is legal.

metas.name: Kindergarten Cop
metas.description: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher in order to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

metas.name: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
metas.description: On the outskirts of Whoville lives a green, revenge-seeking Grinch who plans to ruin Christmas for all of the citizens of the town.

metas.name: Anora
metas.description: A young stripper from Brooklyn impulsively marries the son of Russian oligarchs, but her fairy tale is threatened when his parents set out for New York to get the marriage annulled.

metas.name: It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
metas.description: The Peanuts gang celebrates Halloween while Linus waits for the Great Pumpkin.

metas.name: Remarkably Bright Creatures
metas.description: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A bedridden boy's grandfather reads him the story of a farmboy-turned-pirate who encounters numerous obstacles, enemies and allies in his quest to be reunited with his true love.

metas.name: Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

metas.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

metas.name: Voicemails for Isabelle
metas.description: Jill leaves voice messages to her deceased sister telling her about her chaotic life in San Francisco. Unwittingly, a mysterious Austin TX real estate agent begins to receive their confessions..

metas.name: In Bruges
metas.description: After a job gone wrong, hitman Ray and his partner await orders from their ruthless boss in Bruges, Belgium, the last place in the world Ray wants to be.

metas.name: Deadpool & Wolverine
metas.description: Deadpool is offered a place in the Marvel Cinematic Universe by the Time Variance Authority, but instead recruits a variant of Wolverine to save his universe from extinction.

metas.name: Seven Psychopaths
metas.description: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

metas.name: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
metas.description: Mario ventures into space, exploring cosmic worlds and tackling galactic challenges far from the familiar Mushroom Kingdom.

metas.name: Dead Poets Society
metas.description: A maverick teacher at a prestigious New England boys' boarding school uses poetry to embolden his pupils to new heights of self-expression.

metas.name: Haunted Mansion
metas.description: A single mom named Gabbie hires a tour guide, a psychic, a priest and a historian to help exorcise her newly bought mansion after discovering it is inhabited by ghosts.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.

metas.name: Gail Daughtry and the Celebrity Sex Pass
metas.description: When her fiancé uses their "celebrity pass" agreement, Midwest bride Gail Daughtry travels to Hollywood seeking revenge by pursuing her own celebrity encounter.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: Two lifelong friends find themselves at an impasse when one abruptly ends their relationship, with alarming consequences for both of them.

metas.name: The Holiday
metas.description: Amanda lives in LA and is a movie trailer editor. Iris lives in Surrey and is a journalist. The two decide to swap houses for two weeks at Christmas - both trying to forget their troubled love lives, until love finds them anyway.

metas.name: The Grinch
metas.description: A grumpy Grinch plots to ruin Christmas for the village of Whoville.

metas.name: Practical Magic
metas.description: Two witch sisters, raised by their eccentric aunts in a small town, face closed-minded prejudice and a curse which threatens to prevent them ever finding lasting love.

metas.name: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
metas.description: A Chicago advertising man must struggle to travel home from New York for Thanksgiving, with a lovable oaf of a shower-curtain-ring salesman as his only companion.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: A group of intergalactic criminals must pull together to stop a fanatical warrior with plans to purge the universe.

metas.name: Mickey 17
metas.description: During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.

metas.name: Green Book
metas.description: A working-class Italian-American bouncer becomes the driver for an African-American classical pianist on a tour of venues through the 1960s American South.

metas.name: 10 Things I Hate About You
metas.description: A high-school boy, Cameron, cannot date Bianca until her anti-social older sister, Kat, has a boyfriend. So, Cameron pays a mysterious boy, Patrick, to charm Kat.

metas.name: The Devil Wears Prada 2
metas.description: Andy Sachs reunites with Miranda Priestly as they navigate their careers amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: When renowned crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead at his estate just after his 85th birthday, the inquisitive and debonair Detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously enlisted to investigate.

metas.name: Snatch
metas.description: Unscrupulous boxing promoters, violent bookmakers, a Russian gangster, incompetent amateur robbers and supposedly Jewish jewelers fight to track down a priceless stolen diamond.

metas.name: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
metas.description: A young boy from an impoverished family joins four other kids on a tour of an amazing chocolate factory run by an imaginative chocolatier.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.

metas.name: Life Is Beautiful
metas.description: When an open-minded Jewish waiter and his son become victims of the Holocaust, he uses a perfect mixture of will, humor and imagination to protect his son from the dangers around their camp.

metas.name: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
metas.description: Four teenagers are sucked into a magical video game, and the only way they can escape is to work together to finish the game.

metas.name: The Hangover
metas.description: Three buddies wake up from a bachelor party in Las Vegas with no memory of the previous night and the bachelor missing. They must make their way around the city in order to find their friend in time for his wedding.

metas.name: Cold Storage
metas.description: When a highly dangerous fungus escapes from a secret laboratory, a former bioterrorism agent is called back into action. Alongside two young employees, he must confront an invisible and out-of-control threat.

metas.name: You've Got Mail
metas.description: Book superstore magnate Joe Fox and independent book shop owner Kathleen Kelly fall in love in the anonymity of the Internet, both blissfully unaware that he's trying to put her out of business.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All at Once
metas.description: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.

metas.name: The Intouchables
metas.description: After he becomes a quadriplegic from a paragliding accident, an aristocrat hires a young man from the projects to be his caregiver.

metas.name: Bridesmaids
metas.description: Competition between the maid of honor and a bridesmaid, over who is the bride's best friend, threatens to upend the life of an out-of-work pastry chef.

metas.name: Poor Things
metas.description: An account of the fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter.

metas.name: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
metas.description: Kevin is separated from his family again when he accidentally boards a flight to New York City during a Christmas trip to Miami. However he crosses paths with the same burglars, who now plan to rob a toy store on Christmas Eve.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: At the age of 21, Tim discovers he can travel in time and change what happens and has happened in his own life. His decision to make his world a better place by getting a girlfriend turns out not to be as easy as you might think.

metas.name: American Pie
metas.description: Four teenage boys enter a pact to lose their virginity by prom night.

metas.name: We're the Millers
metas.description: A veteran pot dealer creates a fake family as part of his plan to move a huge shipment of weed into the U.S. from Mexico.

metas.name: They Will Kill You
metas.description: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a NYC high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realizes the community is shrouded in mystery.

metas.name: No Other Choice
metas.description: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

metas.name: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
metas.description: A middle-aged husband's life changes dramatically when his wife asks him for a divorce. He seeks to rediscover his manhood with help from new acquaintance Jacob, who teaches him to pick up women at bars.

metas.name: Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: Lucky follows the spiritual journey of a 90-year-old atheist and the quirky characters that inhabit his off the map desert town.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: Five assassins aboard a swiftly-moving bullet train find out that their missions have something in common.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: La La Land
metas.description: When Sebastian, a pianist, and Mia, an actress, follow their passion and achieve success in their respective fields, they find themselves torn between their love for each other and their careers.

metas.name: The Goonies
metas.description: A group of young misfits called The Goonies discover an ancient map and set out on an adventure to find a legendary pirate's long-lost treasure.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: Through a series of freak occurrences, a group of actors shooting a big-budget war movie are forced to become the soldiers they are portraying.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: The owner of an aging high-class hotel regales a writer with tales of serving as a lobby boy under an exceptional concierge in the hotel's glory years.

metas.name: Airplane!
metas.description: After the crew becomes sick with food poisoning, a neurotic ex-fighter pilot must safely land a commercial airplane full of passengers.

metas.name: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
metas.description: Grace MacCaullay battles old wounds with her estranged sister Faith MacCaullay while rival occult dynasties hunt them through a deadly contest that promises power, survival, and betrayal before dawn.

metas.name: No Hard Feelings
metas.description: On the brink of losing her home, Maddie finds an intriguing job listing: helicopter parents looking for someone to bring their introverted 19-year-old son out of his shell before college. She has one summer to make him a man or di...

metas.name: The Holdovers
metas.description: In 1970, a curmudgeonly history teacher at a New England boarding school remains on campus during Christmas break to supervise held over students, and ends up forming an unlikely bond with a brainy but damaged troublemaker.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Cady Heron is a hit with The Plastics, the A-list girl clique at her new school, until she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

metas.name: Ratatouille
metas.description: A rat who can cook makes an unusual alliance with a young kitchen worker at a famous Paris restaurant.

metas.name: 500 Days of Summer
metas.description: After being dumped by the girl he believes to be his soulmate, hopeless romantic Tom Hansen reflects on their relationship to try and figure out where things went wrong and how he can win her back.

metas.name: Hook
metas.description: When Captain James Hook kidnaps his children, an adult Peter Pan must return to Neverland and reclaim his youthful spirit in order to challenge his old enemy.

metas.name: A League of Their Own
metas.description: During World War II, sisters Dottie and Kit join the first female professional baseball league and struggle to help it succeed amid their own growing rivalry.
